baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence from circling youths through seeing, reckoning, pearls, and scattering.
baseline_models.mechanism: Stable young agents remain in motion around the beneficiaries, while the seeing-reckoning construction converts their separated bodies into points of pearl-like light. Permanence belongs to the agents, mobility to their service, and dispersion to the viewer's composite image.

activation_trace.role: Literal circling supplies the repeated orbital motion around the beneficiaries.
Born offspring supplies the youthful human plurality occupying the orbit.
Enduring permanence keeps the moving figures from aging or decaying.
Direct sight makes the comparison an event in the observer's visual field.
Suppositional reckoning marks the pearl image as a judgment produced by sight.
Gleaming sparkle supplies the point-like luminosity of each figure.
Scattering apart supplies the distributed geometry of the whole group.

changed_reading.before: Many youthful attendants are decoratively compared to pearls.
changed_reading.after: The ayah choreographs an enduring service orbit that resolves in sight as a distributed luminous field.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The immediate construction 'when you see them, you reckon them' followed by a scattered plural image.
baseline_models.mechanism: Seeing becomes both classification and enumeration. Sparkle makes the figures visually discrete, scattering prevents them from forming one mass, and reckoning oscillates between counting the points and mistaking persons for pearls.

activation_trace.role: Visible appearance frames the figures as a composed scene rather than isolated identities.
Counting turns the many bright figures into enumerable visual units.
Supposition keeps the enumeration perceptual and provisional rather than literal identity.
Sparkle supplies the repeated visual signal that can be counted.
Separation distributes the countable signals across space.

changed_reading.before: The pearl phrase is a straightforward comparison of beauty.
changed_reading.after: The phrase records a productive visual misreckoning in which abundance is perceived as countable, scattered flashes.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The juxtaposition of the participle from خ ل د with pearls spread across a field.
baseline_models.mechanism: A branch of the participle's root names adornment fixed to the body, while pearl and body-spread covering branches make the youths readable as living jewelry laid across the scene. Their agency remains in the circling verb, preventing the image from collapsing into literal objects.

activation_trace.role: A fixed bodily adornment supplies a decorative overtone to the participle.
The pearl supplies the actual substance and value of the ornament image.
A covering spread over a body supplies the image of ornament distributed over a larger whole.
Circling preserves the figures as active living agents within the decorative reading.

changed_reading.before: The participle describes only unending youth.
changed_reading.after: It can also tint the youths as fixed adornment made animate, with their pearl-like bodies ornamenting the whole environment.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus verb of seeing has a packet-supplied non-dominant mapping to ر و ي alongside the direct visual mapping.
baseline_models.mechanism: The split mapping lets the act of seeing carry latent images of quenching, water-bearing, fullness, and beautiful appearance. Even before context, the figures can be read as visually refreshing presences whose beauty satisfies the gaze rather than merely resembling gems.

activation_trace.role: Quenching supplies a satisfaction metaphor for the act of seeing.
Bringing water gives the seen figures a latent role as bearers of refreshment.
Beauty of appearance connects the form-distant mapping back to the explicit visual construction.
Sparkle gives the visually refreshing appearance a concrete focus-ayah signal.

changed_reading.before: Seeing is a neutral optical precondition for the pearl comparison.
changed_reading.after: Seeing itself can be a quenching encounter with a full and beautiful appearance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah first makes perceptive capacity part of a test that reveals condition; the focus then stages sight immediately producing a supposition. The pearl reckoning therefore becomes an instance of tested judgment, not only an ornamental report.

activation_trace.role: Direct sight supplies the faculty exercised in the focus construction.
Supposition supplies the potentially fallible judgment generated by sight.
Testing that reveals a condition turns perceptual response into diagnostic evidence.
Insight extends the created capacity beyond bare retinal registration to judgment.

structural_cues: 76:2 places testing before the making of the human as hearing and seeing; 76:19 places seeing immediately before reckoning.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a test that reveals condition, created perception, and a sight-to-supposition sequence; I infer that the later reckoning exemplifies the tested faculty. A live alternative is that 76:2 is only a general anthropological preface.

changed_reading.before: The observer simply notices an exceptionally beautiful group.
changed_reading.after: The observer's pearl judgment displays how a created perceptual faculty converts appearance into a provisional account.

context_deltas.mechanism: A movement-and-service reversal links fettered bodies, voluntary feeding of a captive, and the later unrestricted circulation of youths. The orbit is no longer primarily a prestige display: it answers constrained need with abundant, mobile care.

activation_trace.role: Circling gives the reward scene its conspicuous freedom and continuity of movement.
The youthful human plurality embodies the mobile care rather than an abstract provision.
A collar that binds a limb establishes the surah's negative pole of arrested movement.
Giving food supplies the voluntary service that the later mobile care answers.
Binding and confinement identify the recipient of earlier care as movement-restricted.

structural_cues: 76:4 binds the condemned, 76:8 feeds a captive, and 76:19 foregrounds uninterrupted circulation around the rewarded.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies restraint, care for a restrained person, and later mobile attendance; I supply the reciprocal arrow from compassionate service to service made freely mobile. The alternative is a simple juxtaposition of punishment, virtue, and reward.

changed_reading.before: Circulating attendants chiefly signal elevated status.
changed_reading.after: Their circulation embodies a social reversal in which care given across confinement returns as care without impediment.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated drinking, a spring immediately before the focus, and acts of giving drink activate the focus verb's non-dominant water branches. The act of seeing becomes quenching, while the pearl-like figures become visually liquid carriers of refreshment.

activation_trace.role: Quenching lets the visual encounter satisfy the gaze as water satisfies thirst.
Water-bearing gives the circulating figures a latent delivery function.
Sparkle renders the hydric reading as bright droplet-like points within the focus image.
Taking in liquid establishes refreshment as a repeated material action in the surah.
A flowing spring immediately before the focus supplies the local water source.
Quenching a drinker supplies the action echoed by the split focus mapping.

structural_cues: 76:17-18 place being given drink and a named spring directly before 76:19, while drinking recurs in 76:5-6 and 76:21.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a split focus mapping with quenching and water-bearing branches inside a dense drinking sequence; I transfer that hydric force onto seeing and visual service. The dominant optical reading remains fully live and may carry the water sense only as resonance.

changed_reading.before: The youths are visually attractive attendants located near a spring.
changed_reading.after: Their appearance quenches the gaze and continues the surah's flow of refreshment in a visual register.

context_deltas.mechanism: The feared day's evil is imaged as a light, spreading danger, including a branch of flying sparks; the focus later distributes harmless gleams as scattered pearls. The same outward geometry changes valence from invasive threat to ordered delight.

activation_trace.role: Gleaming sparkle supplies the benign luminous particles of the later scene.
Scattering supplies the outward distribution whose valence is reversed.
Flying fire-sparks supply a dangerous earlier image of luminous particles spreading outward.
Spread following light motion supplies the threatening distribution pattern.

structural_cues: The feared spreading day in 76:7 precedes protection from its evil in 76:11 and the scattered pearl field in 76:19.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two outward-spreading images, one dangerous and one brilliant; I infer a formal reversal through the intervening protection. They may alternatively be unrelated descriptions sharing only spatial vocabulary.

changed_reading.before: Scattering only conveys the attendants' abundance and beauty.
changed_reading.after: Their scattered gleam is also the redeemed inverse of a threat that had spread like airborne sparks.

context_deltas.mechanism: The adjacent verse repeats the conditional act of seeing and expands its object from the youths to bliss and great dominion. The focus figures therefore operate as a local aperture or index through which the observer apprehends the total environment.

activation_trace.role: Visible appearance makes the youths the first bounded scene presented to the observer.
Supposition records the observer's first interpretive response to that scene.
Repeated visible appearance reopens and widens the visual field immediately after the focus.
Excellent condition names the encompassing quality disclosed beyond the local figures.
Dominion expands the scale from moving persons to the ordered realm they manifest.
The magnitude of the matter marks the expansion beyond an isolated decorative detail.

structural_cues: 76:19 and 76:20 use adjacent if-you-see constructions, with the second adding a deictic field and widening the objects of vision.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies immediate syntactic repetition and a scale expansion from figures to bliss and dominion; I infer that the figures serve as the perceptual threshold of the larger realm. The alternative is that 76:20 resets the gaze without assigning the youths an indexing function.

changed_reading.before: The ayah is a self-contained portrait of attendants.
changed_reading.after: The attendants are the first visible sample through which the next verse's total bliss and dominion become apprehensible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The scene explicitly lacks a central sun yet accumulates reflective silver, glass, and sparkling pearls. The scattered youths can therefore function visually as decentralized illumination: many mobile gleams replace one overhead source.

activation_trace.role: Pearl sparkle supplies many local points of reflected brightness.
Scattering distributes those points throughout the visual field.
The explicitly negated sun removes the ordinary centralized source of daylight.
Silver supplies the reflective material field that precedes the pearl comparison.

structural_cues: No sun is seen in 76:13; silver and glass dominate 76:15-16; scattered pearl-like figures appear in 76:19.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the absent sun and multiple reflective materials; I assign the scattered sparkle a local lighting function. A live alternative is that sunlessness concerns comfort and the materials concern luxury without an illumination mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Pearl sparkle is a surface description of the youths.
changed_reading.after: Their distributed sparkle helps compose a sunless environment whose light is plural, mobile, and near.

context_deltas.mechanism: Near shade, deliberately lowered fruit, circulating vessels, and circulating youths form one access system. Goods and agents move toward the beneficiaries, and the pearl-like scattering reads as spatial coverage rather than random decoration.

activation_trace.role: The youths' circling is the final mobile layer of the access system.
Spatial scattering supplies broad service coverage around the beneficiaries.
Nearness establishes that environmental provisions approach their users.
Making something easy after difficulty supplies the removal of access friction.
A near fruit cluster gives the access mechanism a concrete provision within reach.
The prior circulation of vessels establishes delivery by orbit before the youths repeat it.

structural_cues: 76:14 brings shade and fruit near, 76:15 circulates vessels, and 76:19 repeats the circulation with distributed agents.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies nearness, facilitation, reachable fruit, and two successive circulation constructions; I infer a unified logistics of effortless access. The alternative is a sequence of independent pleasures without a common delivery mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The youths wander around as courtly attendants.
changed_reading.after: They complete an environment engineered so that care, drink, and beauty are continuously present at every point of need.

context_deltas.mechanism: Silver capable of dispersal, glass vessels, and exact fitting-to-measure precede the focus's counted, scattered pearls. Apparent randomness is therefore held inside calibration: the viewer sees abundance distributed with designed proportion.

activation_trace.role: Counting supplies the observer's apprehension of multiplicity and order.
Pearls provide discrete valuable units capable of patterned distribution.
Scattering supplies the apparent irregularity that calibration revises.
Dispersed fragments activate a material bridge from silver to the later scattered pearl field.
The glass vessel supplies transparent bounded form immediately before the measured action.
Fitting a thing to its proper measure supplies calibration within the visual abundance.

structural_cues: 76:15-16 stresses silver, transparent vessels, and exact measure; 76:19 answers with reckoning and scattering.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measured vessels, dispersible silver, and focus-ayah counting and scattering; I extend calibration from vessels to the scene's distribution. The live alternative limits measure strictly to vessel capacity.

changed_reading.before: Scattered pearls evoke lavish but random profusion.
changed_reading.after: The scattered appearance is a deliberately measured distribution whose irregular surface conceals exact provision.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus root's fixed-adornment branch gains local support when the next reward description explicitly ornaments bodies with encircling bracelets. The pearl-like youths become living jewelry of the realm while their verb preserves movement and agency.

activation_trace.role: Adornment fixed to ear or hand supplies the unusual decorative overtone in the focus participle.
Pearl substance makes the decorative overtone materially visible.
Circling converts fixed ornament into an animated environmental layer.
Explicit bodily ornament confirms that adornment is active in the adjacent reward scene.
A bracelet encircling the hand concretizes the fixed bodily location named by the focus branch.

structural_cues: The pearl-like youths of 76:19 are followed in 76:21 by explicit silver adornment encircling bodies.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a fixed-adornment focus branch and adjacent bracelets; I let that branch color the participle without replacing its permanence sense. The alternative is that the adornment branch is merely homonymous and contextually inactive.

changed_reading.before: The youths are permanent persons who happen to look like pearls.
changed_reading.after: They also act as the realm's permanent ornament made mobile and alive.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it relocates the pearl field into the beholder's eye rather than the external scene. It remains anchored in the focus seeing and appearance construction and in the packet's human-image-in-the-pupil branch; downstream prose should mark it as an optical miniature or reflection, not as a claim that the youths are unreal.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The second-person seeing construction and the conversion of human figures into small sparkling appearances.

activation_trace.role: Visible appearance and mirror imagery allow the scene to be considered as an image formed in sight.
Sparkle supplies the tiny bright points produced in the reflected image.
The human figure imaged in the eye's dark center supplies a packet-internal optical miniature.
Physical eyesight supplies the apparatus in which the miniature pearl-like figures appear.

changed_reading.before: The observer looks outward at attendants distributed in space.
changed_reading.after: Their external distribution is momentarily miniaturized inside the observer's pupil as a field of sparkling human reflections.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads natal materiality through a courtly image. It remains anchored in the focus's youths, the root branch for birth, and the focus branch of a womb scattering offspring, then gains context from mixed generative fluid and womb imagery; downstream prose should present it as a latent birth-to-jewel transformation, not literal obstetrics in paradise.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The conjunction of youths, enduring generation, pearls, and a scattering adjective whose inventory includes a prolific womb.

activation_trace.role: Birth and delivery make the youthful plurality an explicitly generated population.
A womb scattering many children gives the final adjective a natal distribution image.
Pearl substance supplies the transformed precious outcome of the generative process.
Fluid ranging from droplet to generative seed supplies the surah's initial human material.
Mixture supplies the compositional process from which the human plurality begins.
The womb branch closes the surah with a bodily container that reactivates the focus's prolific-scattering branch.

changed_reading.before: The youths are a finished decorative population.
changed_reading.after: They can faintly image generated humanity transformed from mixed fluid into an inexhaustible dispersion of precious life.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is cross-domain because it maps a later worship schedule onto the youths' spatial orbit. It remains anchored in the focus circling verb and is supported by the complete morning-evening-night cycle plus swimming motion; downstream prose should call it a temporal or liturgical resonance, not identify the attendants as ritual performers.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The repeated circling action of the youths around a center.

activation_trace.role: Circling supplies the spatial cycle to which the later temporal cycle can attach.
The beginning of day supplies the first station in a complete recurring cycle.
Evening supplies the opposed daylight station that completes the daily arc.
Night extends the cycle through darkness and makes its continuity explicit.
Swimming or running motion gives the temporal worship cycle a kinetic analogue to orbit.

changed_reading.before: The youths' circulation is purely spatial service movement.
changed_reading.after: Their orbit can also resonate with service that continuously cycles through morning, evening, and night.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it shifts permanence from personal duration toward persistence of form or role. It stays anchored in enduring youths, derived plurality, and repeated pearl-like units, while the context explicitly joins bodily binding to replacement by likenesses; downstream prose should retain individual permanence as the ordinary reading and present form-persistence only as a secondary systems model.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Enduring generated youths perceived as many mutually similar pearl units.

activation_trace.role: Enduring permanence supplies the stable property requiring explanation.
A thing generated from another allows the plurality to be viewed as recurring instances.
Repeated pearl units supply visual equivalence among the many figures.
Tight bodily binding supplies the integrity of each embodied instance.
One thing standing in another's place supplies instance-level replacement.
A counterpart or likeness supplies continuity of form across replacement.

changed_reading.before: Each youthful attendant simply continues forever as the same individual.
changed_reading.after: At the edge of the packet's branch space, the enduring quality can describe a stable pearl-like form or service role instantiated without depletion.

strongest_changes: The circling youths complete a surah-wide access system of near, lowered, and continuously delivered provision.
Measured silver and glass revise scattered pearls from random profusion into calibrated distribution.
Captivity and feeding transform mobile attendance from status display into a reciprocal reversal of constrained need.
The adjacent repetition of seeing makes the youths a perceptual threshold into the total bliss and dominion of 76:20.
The split ر ء ي mapping becomes newly active inside the dense spring-and-drink sequence, allowing sight itself to feel quenching.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet repeatedly changed the focus through mechanisms of motion, distribution, perception, and material flow. The most productive surprise was that the pearl simile is not static: it coordinates service logistics, exact measure, decentralized luminosity, social reversal, and a gaze that moves from local figures to the entire realm.
remaining_uncertainties: The hydric reading depends on a non-dominant split mapping and should remain resonance rather than lexical replacement.
The fixed-adornment branch of خ ل د is locally supported by 76:21 but may remain secondary to enduring permanence.
The pupil, natal, liturgical, and replaceable-form models are branch-anchored but intentionally exploratory and should not be synthesized as settled meanings.
The inferred reversal from spreading threat to scattered sparkle is formal and spatial; the packet does not state a direct causal link.
